question: I'm a CS 5th-year student on academic warning. I've been offered a fantastic opportunity to study at another campus abroad next semester. Am I permitted to participate in the study abroad program?
expected_answer: No — the academic actions policy explicitly states that a student on an academic action (including academic warning) cannot study abroad. P-009 must first return to good academic standing before being eligible for study abroad programs.
reasoning_type: Academic action policy — study abroad restriction
common_mistake: Assuming study abroad is a separate administrative process unaffected by academic standing; not knowing the study abroad restriction is part of the academic action consequences
needs_verification: Confirm P-009's current academic standing is academic warning
Confirm the CMU-Q policy explicitly includes study abroad as a prohibited activity during academic warning
Confirm whether any exception process exists if the opportunity is exceptional
